title: Savanna Animals for Kids! Meet 5 Zoo Friends with Milo
description:
Join Milo the bluebird for a 5-minute zoo adventure! Meet the Giraffe, Elephant, Lion, Zebra and Hippo, and learn a surprise fact about each one. 🐾
Made for curious kids ages 3–8: guess-the-animal clues, move-along fun, and a recap at the end.

What we learn today:
• Giraffes have purple tongues.
• Elephants can't jump, but they can swim.
• You can hear a lion roar from five miles away.
• Every zebra has its own stripes.
• And hippos make their own sunscreen!

Our zoo rule: be kind to every animal, watch quietly and give them space. 💙

title: Baby Pandas Are Born Pink!
description:
You were a baby once. A baby panda is pink, and as small as a stick of butter! Can you believe it? Milo the bluebird visits the pandas to find out! 🐼
A fun animal fact Short for kids ages 3–8 from The Animated Zoo.

Pandas turn black and white as they grow up. They eat bamboo for about half of the day! A special bump on their wrist helps them hold the bamboo.
Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo! 💙

#Shorts #AnimalFacts #Panda #KidsLearning

title: Baby Kangaroos Are Jelly Bean Size!
description:

A fun animal fact Short for kids ages 3–8 from The Animated Zoo.

A baby kangaroo is called a joey. It lives in its mom's pouch. It stays safe and warm in there, and grows big and strong. Then one day, it's ready to hop out!
Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo! 💙

title: Why Are Some Sloths Green?
description:

A fun animal fact Short for kids ages 3–8 from The Animated Zoo.

Sloths hang upside down in the trees. Tiny plants called algae grow on their fur. The green helps them hide in the leaves!
